in_marathi.name: Sharulaksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge and Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharulaksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharulaksha is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Sharu meaning 'knowledge' and Akshi meaning 'eye'. This name signifies the Goddess of Knowledge and Protection, who is believed to bestow wisdom and shield her devotees from harm.
